title: Rose Castile
html_source: Rose of Castile although referring to opera, more importantly refers to Molly throughout this book. Castile was an ancient kingdom in Spain and Bloom has already mentioned Molly’s ostensible Spanish origins, so she seems to be dubbed the Rose of Castile. Here Bloom is talking about how Molly left him alone last summer, presumably was having an affair with someone. Bloom felt very lonely.
